en.title: Agency ladder · L1 → L2 → L3
en.description: Step one support ticket up the agency ladder: Switch rules (no LLM), then one AI Agent with memory, then Reply + Risk specialists behind one human gate — without API keys.

steps.content: Triage fixture ticket WL-1026: "I was charged twice. I need this fixed today or I will file a complaint." Route to low, medium, or high on L1, then L2, then L3.
steps.annotation: Same fixture ticket climbs every rung. Labels stay fixed.

steps.content: Starting at L1: a Switch with keyword rules — no LLM. Duplicate charge + same-day urgency + complaint should hit HIGH.
steps.annotation: L1 mechanism — rules only. Import n8n-triage-l1-switch.json; no credential.

steps.content: {"ticket_id":"WL-1026","rules":["charged twice","today","complaint"],"branch":"high"}
steps.annotation: L1 Switch fires the high branch from keyword hits.

steps.content: {"priority":"high","level":"L1","llm":false,"match":"fixture"}
steps.annotation: L1 label matches the shared fixture. Gate before climbing to L2.

steps.content: LEVEL UP · L1 → L2 — same tickets, add one bounded AI Agent with memory. Agent proposes; human reviews before accept.
steps.annotation: Solo bar today = L2. Never silent auto-send.

steps.content: {"ticket_id":"WL-1026","memory":"prior:high on similar refunds","propose":"high"}
steps.annotation: L2 — AI Agent + memory drafts a priority (n8n-triage-l2-agent-memory.json).

steps.content: {"priority":"high","confidence":0.86,"needs_human_review":true}
steps.annotation: Proposal only. Human must review before anything customer-facing.

steps.content: HUMAN GATE · L2 Review — facilitator checks proposed high against the fixture. Mismatch → fix rules/prompt, never invent a label.
steps.annotation: Human decides. An import is not a model run — claim L2 with a trace.

steps.content: LEVEL UP · L2 → L3 (stretch) — split Customer Reply and Risk as specialists; keep one explicit human gate.
steps.annotation: L3 is stretch. Same tickets; more agency.

steps.content: {"ticket_id":"WL-1026","roles":["customer_reply","risk"],"priority":"high","gate":"human_approval_required"}
steps.annotation: L3 — n8n-triage-l3-multi-agent.json: Reply drafts, Risk flags, one gate.

steps.content: {"reply_draft":"Apologies for the double charge — refund queued pending approval.","risk":"refund_sensitive","priority":"high","awaiting_gate":true}
steps.annotation: Joint output waits on the single human gate — never silent auto-send.

steps.content: WL-1026 climbed L1→L2→L3 as high. Proof pack: export or screenshot, L/M/H rules in one paragraph, human gate named, achieved level ≥ L2.
steps.annotation: Agency ladder closed for one ticket. Pedagogy (Apple bar) and n8n starters unchanged.

nl.title: Agency-ladder · L1 → L2 → L3
nl.description: Stap één supportticket de agency-ladder op: Switch-regels (geen LLM), daarna één AI Agent met memory, daarna Reply + Risk-specialisten achter één menselijke gate — zonder API-sleutels.

steps.content: Triage fixture-ticket WL-1026: "I was charged twice. I need this fixed today or I will file a complaint." Routeer naar low, medium of high op L1, daarna L2, daarna L3.
steps.annotation: Hetzelfde fixture-ticket klimt elke sport. Labels blijven vast.

steps.content: Start bij L1: een Switch met keyword-regels — geen LLM. Dubbele afschrijving + same-day urgentie + klacht moet op HIGH landen.
steps.annotation: L1-mechanisme — alleen regels. Importeer n8n-triage-l1-switch.json; geen credential.

steps.content: {"ticket_id":"WL-1026","rules":["charged twice","today","complaint"],"branch":"high"}
steps.annotation: L1 Switch vuurt de high-tak af op keyword-hits.

steps.content: {"priority":"high","level":"L1","llm":false,"match":"fixture"}
steps.annotation: L1-label matcht de gedeelde fixture. Gate vóór je naar L2 klimt.

steps.content: LEVEL UP · L1 → L2 — dezelfde tickets, plus één begrensde AI Agent met memory. Agent stelt voor; mens reviewt vóór acceptatie.
steps.annotation: Solo-lat vandaag = L2. Nooit stille auto-send.

steps.content: {"ticket_id":"WL-1026","memory":"prior:high on similar refunds","propose":"high"}
steps.annotation: L2 — AI Agent + memory stelt een prioriteit voor (n8n-triage-l2-agent-memory.json).

steps.content: {"priority":"high","confidence":0.86,"needs_human_review":true}
steps.annotation: Alleen een voorstel. Een mens moet reviewen vóór iets klantgericht wordt.

steps.content: MENSELIJKE GATE · L2 Review — facilitator checkt voorgesteld high tegen de fixture. Mismatch → regels/prompt verbeteren, nooit een nieuw label verzinnen.
steps.annotation: De mens beslist. Een import is geen modelrun — claim L2 met een trace.

steps.content: LEVEL UP · L2 → L3 (stretch) — splits Customer Reply en Risk als specialisten; houd één expliciete menselijke gate.
steps.annotation: L3 is stretch. Dezelfde tickets; meer agency.

steps.content: {"ticket_id":"WL-1026","roles":["customer_reply","risk"],"priority":"high","gate":"human_approval_required"}
steps.annotation: L3 — n8n-triage-l3-multi-agent.json: Reply schrijft, Risk markeert, één gate.

steps.content: {"reply_draft":"Excuses voor de dubbele afschrijving — refund in de wachtrij hangt van goedkeuring af.","risk":"refund_sensitive","priority":"high","awaiting_gate":true}
steps.annotation: Gezamenlijke output wacht op de ene menselijke gate — nooit stille auto-send.

steps.content: WL-1026 klom L1→L2→L3 als high. Proof-pakket: export of screenshot, L/M/H-regels in één alinea, menselijke gate benoemd, behaald niveau ≥ L2.
steps.annotation: Agency-ladder sluit voor één ticket. Pedagogie (Apple-bar) en n8n-starters ongewijzigd.
